title: Associated points of flat pullback over a locally Noetherian scheme
statement:
Let $h:Y\to Z$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism], with $Z$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $\mathcal G$ be any quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For a module $\mathcal H$ on a scheme $W$, write $\operatorname{Ass}_W(\mathcal H)$ for the points whose stalk maximal ideal is the annihilator of an element of $\mathcal H_w$, as in [def-trf-relative-assassin]. For $z\in Z$, let $Y_z$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and $j_z:Y_z\to Y$ its projection. Then, as subsets of $Y$,
$$\operatorname{Ass}_Y(h^*\mathcal G)=\bigcup_{z\in\operatorname{Ass}_Z(\mathcal G)}j_z\bigl(\operatorname{Ass}_{Y_z}(\mathcal O_{Y_z})\bigr).$$
Here $h^*$ is pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. No finite-type hypothesis on $\mathcal G$, and no local Noetherianity hypothesis on $Y$, is imposed.

source.place: Tag 05DB (lemma-bourbaki), equality for a locally Noetherian base, specialized to the relatively flat sheaf O_Y; O_Y tensor h^*G = h^*G.

proof.text: Fix $y\in Y$ and put $z=h(y)$, $A=\mathcal O_{Z,z}$, $B=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ and $M=\mathcal G_z$. Apply [lem-trf-flat-association-stalk-dictionary] to $h,\mathcal G,y$. It gives a flat local map $A\to B$, a Noetherian base ring $A$, the tensor description of the pullback stalk, and the closed-fibre quotient $C=B/\mathfrak m_A B$. It also identifies association of $y$, of $z$, and of the unique fibre point $y_z$ with the three maximal-ideal association conditions. All hypotheses are precisely those of the item.

source.place: Tag 05DB (lemma-bourbaki), proof: local rings and the geometric/algebraic dictionary

proof.text: The rings $A,B$ are nonzero local rings since they are scheme stalks at points; step 1 supplies locality, flatness and Noetherianity of $A$. Apply [lem-trf-flat-local-maximal-associated-tensor] to $A,B,M$ and $C=B/\mathfrak m_A B$. If $y\in\operatorname{Ass}_Y(h^*\mathcal G)$, [lem-trf-flat-association-stalk-dictionary](2) gives $\mathfrak m_B\in\operatorname{Ass}_B(M\otimes_A B)$. The forward algebra implication gives $\mathfrak m_A\in\operatorname{Ass}_A(M)$ and $\mathfrak m_B\in\operatorname{Ass}_B(C)$, which the dictionary translates to $z\in\operatorname{Ass}_Z(\mathcal G)$ and $y_z\in\operatorname{Ass}_{Y_z}(\mathcal O_{Y_z})$. Conversely these two geometric conditions give those same two algebraic conditions by the dictionary; the reverse algebra implication followed by dictionary (2) gives $y\in\operatorname{Ass}_Y(h^*\mathcal G)$. Thus both directions use the criterion with exactly its stated hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 05DB (lemma-bourbaki), proof: Bourbaki closed-fibre criterion and substitution

proof.text: By [def-pc-scheme-fibre], $j_t$ is a homeomorphism onto $h^{-1}(t)$ for every $t\in Z$. If $y=j_t(v)$ with $t\in\operatorname{Ass}_Z(\mathcal G)$ and $v\in\operatorname{Ass}_{Y_t}(\mathcal O_{Y_t})$, then $t=h(y)=z$ and injectivity gives $v=y_z$. Conversely, if $z\in\operatorname{Ass}_Z(\mathcal G)$ and $y_z\in\operatorname{Ass}_{Y_z}(\mathcal O_{Y_z})$, the witness $j_z(y_z)=y$ puts $y$ in the union. Thus membership in that union is exactly the right side of step 2, and extensionality proves the equality.

source.place: Tag 05DB (lemma-bourbaki), proof: pointwise equivalence gives the union equality

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q68-c2759cb04 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Fourth push of the 2026-10-21 re-split. The three earlier heads (7162fb8b, ec674bb9, 82ca925e) each passed review. Each landing was then refused only because L had not promoted the side completion to the live DAG. Compared with 82ca925e, both new nodes are byte-identical. In the item, only the wording of proof step 2 changed, now giving the forward and reverse uses of the criterion and dictionary explicitly; it is correct. The statement and the dependency lists are unchanged. All six old proof steps are carried into the two new nodes: the stalk dictionary takes old steps 1, 2 and 5; the local criterion takes old steps 3 and 4 and the algebra of old step 6; the rest of old step 6 became item step 3, so nothing was dropped or summarised. The two nodes are of comparable size, and neither states the union formula. I reread the math. In the local criterion (A Noetherian, B flat and local over A, M arbitrary), the forward direction uses the Bourbaki equality from lem-weil-pbc-associated-primes-flat-base-change, then shows p = m_A: multiplication by an element outside p stays injective after flat tensoring (lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact and lem-weil-pbc-tensor-over-quotient-ring(1)), and locality does the rest. The reverse direction is the containment with p = m_A. Small cases checked: k[x]_(x) with M = A/(x) and M = A, M = 0, and A a field. In the dictionary, the tensor stalk comes from lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback and the fibre stalk C = B/m_A B from lem-sbc-scheme-fibre-stalk-quotient. Ann_B(v) is the preimage of Ann_C(v), and m_A B lies inside m_B by locality, so the comparison holds with no Noetherian hypothesis on B. Item step 3 uses the homeomorphism statement in def-pc-scheme-fibre. Sources read: Stacks divisors.tex 05DB (lemma-bourbaki and its proof) and algebra.tex 05C2. The item equals 05DB with F = O_Y, not weakened. A duplicate search over the current 27455-node snapshot found no duplicate: the nearest candidates are the general Bourbaki node, the flat-quotient node (Noetherian B), the fibre-bound node (finite modules), the fibre module-ring node (only part of dictionary (3)) and the weak-association node. No SGA, no fixes, no tool_uses. Maintainer note: landing still needs L's live-DAG promotion of the side completion.
